note: values read with `git show <revision>:<source>`; see EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md

s.primary.acc.meaning: family-macro exact agreement, beam-4 top-1, owner reference list (primary track)

s.primary.cer.meaning: mean character error rate vs reference

s.proxy.acc.meaning: exact agreement, LLM-suggested spot-checked spellings (proxy track)

e02.phones.meaning: phones − letters, family-macro top-1, mean over 3 paired seeds; paired family bootstrap conditional on the 6 models

e02.phones.ci.meaning: 95% interval of phones − letters, family-macro top-1, mean over 3 paired seeds; paired family bootstrap conditional on the 6 models

sens.s0.donor.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when another word's phones are supplied

sens.s0.nopron.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when the phones are removed

sens.s1.donor.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when another word's phones are supplied

sens.s1.nopron.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when the phones are removed

sens.s2.donor.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when another word's phones are supplied

sens.s2.nopron.meaning: share of top-1 outputs that change when the phones are removed

sens.letters.donor.meaning: letters-only control: change rate under donor phones (must be 0)

e03.phones.meaning: phones − letters on consonant-screened pairs, eval, 3 paired seeds

e03.phones.ci.meaning: 95% interval of phones − letters on consonant-screened pairs, eval, 3 paired seeds

e04.gp.ci.meaning: 95% interval of letters+phones − letters, 3 paired seeds

e04.p.ci.meaning: 95% interval of phones-only − letters (one seed for P)

e05.gp_g8.meaning: top-8 oracle: pooled letters+phones candidates vs letters top-8 (equal budget)

e05.gp_g8.ci.meaning: 95% interval of top-8 oracle: pooled letters+phones candidates vs letters top-8 (equal budget)

e05.gp_gg.meaning: top-8 oracle: pooled letters+phones vs two letters seeds

e05.gp_gg.ci.meaning: 95% interval of top-8 oracle: pooled letters+phones vs two letters seeds

e13.dev.meaning: pronunciation-guided − base adapter, historical dev top-1

e13.dev.ci.meaning: 95% interval of pronunciation-guided − base adapter, historical dev top-1

e13.eval.meaning: pronunciation-guided − base adapter, historical eval top-1

e13.eval.ci.meaning: 95% interval of pronunciation-guided − base adapter, historical eval top-1

e13.mech.missing.meaning: share of historical-dev outputs that change when the reading is removed

e13.mech.wrong.meaning: share of historical-dev outputs that change under another word's reading

e07.vs_g.meaning: corrected ByT5 adapter (registered beam-4) − mean of 3 small letters models, historical eval top-1

e07.vs_g.ci.meaning: 95% interval of corrected ByT5 adapter (registered beam-4) − mean of 3 small letters models, historical eval top-1

e08.vs_e07.meaning: adapter on real+synthetic data − E07, registered beam-4 top-1

e08.vs_e07.ci.meaning: 95% interval of adapter on real+synthetic data − E07, registered beam-4 top-1

e09.e08.sel_vs_reg.meaning: canonical beam (selected) − registered beam-4 (early_stopping=True), synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

e09.e08.sel_vs_reg.ci.meaning: 95% interval of canonical beam (selected) − registered beam-4 (early_stopping=True), synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

e09.e08.greedy_vs_reg.meaning: greedy − registered beam-4, synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

e09.e08.greedy_vs_reg.ci.meaning: 95% interval of greedy − registered beam-4, synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

e09.e08.sel_vs_greedy.meaning: canonical beam − greedy, synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

e09.e08.sel_vs_greedy.ci.meaning: 95% interval of canonical beam − greedy, synthetic-data adapter, historical eval top-1

h.e07.top1.meaning: e07 greedy family-macro exact agreement, historical eval

h.e08.top1.meaning: e08 greedy family-macro exact agreement, historical eval

h.e11.top1.meaning: e11 greedy family-macro exact agreement, historical eval

h.e12.top1.meaning: e12 greedy exact agreement, historical eval

h.e13.top1.meaning: e13 greedy exact agreement, historical eval

e11.vs_e07.meaning: real-data adapter − E07, greedy top-1, historical eval

e11.vs_e07.ci.meaning: 95% interval of real-data adapter − E07, greedy top-1, historical eval

e11.vs_e08.meaning: real-data adapter − adapter with synthetic rows, greedy top-1

e11.vs_e08.ci.meaning: 95% interval of real-data adapter − adapter with synthetic rows, greedy top-1

e12.vs_e11.hist.ci.meaning: 95% interval of 6,000-update − 3,000-update schedule, historical eval top-1

e11.update.meaning: selected update of the released adapter

e12.update.meaning: selected update of the long-schedule run

e13.update.meaning: selected update of the pronunciation-guided run

rev.representative.e07.meaning: e07 greedy spelling judged acceptable, representative dev sample

rev.representative.e08.meaning: e08 greedy spelling judged acceptable, representative dev sample

rev.representative.e11.meaning: e11 greedy spelling judged acceptable, representative dev sample

rev.disagreement.e07.meaning: e07 greedy spelling judged acceptable, disagreement dev sample

rev.disagreement.e08.meaning: e08 greedy spelling judged acceptable, disagreement dev sample

rev.disagreement.e11.meaning: e11 greedy spelling judged acceptable, disagreement dev sample

t1.e11.share.meaning: e11 confirmed-acceptable share (uncertain counts as not confirmed)

t1.e12.share.meaning: e12 confirmed-acceptable share (uncertain counts as not confirmed)

t1.diff.meaning: e12 − e11 confirmed-acceptable share, paired family bootstrap (10,000)

t1.diff.ci.meaning: 95% interval of e12 − e11 confirmed-acceptable share, paired family bootstrap (10,000)

t1.p.meaning: exact two-sided sign test over discordant words

t2.e11.share.meaning: e11 confirmed-acceptable share (uncertain counts as not confirmed)

t2.e13.share.meaning: e13 confirmed-acceptable share (uncertain counts as not confirmed)

t2.diff.meaning: e13 − e11 confirmed-acceptable share, paired family bootstrap (10,000)

t2.diff.ci.meaning: 95% interval of e13 − e11 confirmed-acceptable share, paired family bootstrap (10,000)

t2.p.meaning: exact two-sided sign test over discordant words

t1.ordinary.e12.meaning: e12 acceptable in group ordinary (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

t1.ordinary.e11.meaning: e11 acceptable in group ordinary (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

t1.irregular.e12.meaning: e12 acceptable in group irregular (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

t1.irregular.e11.meaning: e11 acceptable in group irregular (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

t1.names.e12.meaning: e12 acceptable in group names (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

t1.names.e11.meaning: e11 acceptable in group names (E12 REPORT.md §5.1 table)

cov.words.meaning: irregular development words in the coverage diagnostic

cov.greedy.meaning: words whose greedy output is acceptable

cov.beam1.meaning: words whose canonical beam top-1 is acceptable

cov.any4.meaning: words with ≥1 acceptable among 4 beam candidates

cov.recov.meaning: greedy not acceptable but an acceptable beam candidate exists

cov.coverage.meaning: share of candidates with a judgment

cov.gain_vs_greedy.derived_from: cov.any4 − cov.greedy (valid because every greedy-acceptable word is in the any-of-4 set: cov.any5 == cov.any4)

cov.gain_vs_beam1.meaning: oracle words added over beam top-1
cov.gain_vs_beam1.derived_from: cov.any4 − cov.beam1 (beam top-1 is one of the 4)
